role: Manual review assistance only; never changes automatic QT/QTc or reliability
acceptanceRole: Engineering smoke bounds selected on observed development results, not clinical acceptance or prospective validation
reference: Unmodified PR28 evaluator and four-lead references; all existing T peaks retained for identical event matching
limitations: Two tested window widths are not independent detectors. Leads are correlated.
A stable candidate can still be wrong by more than 100ms; never promote QT.
Agreement may exclude biphasic T, U and weak or overlapping waves; missing outputs are explicit.
Aggregate annotations are not a human-adjudicated global endpoint.
Published area-based methods motivate the indicator, not these implementation thresholds or a validation claim.
Existing bad automatic T-end/QT values are unchanged; this is a separately labeled review aid.
